# IR contract fixtures

These are deployed, authored wire examples, not compiler-produced or interpreter
execution goldens. The two report examples illustrate shape only: their counters
are not measured execution results. The invalid/schema manifest records expected
validator kinds and JSON pointers. Tests use only these deployed copies and the
schemas under shared/compiler-contracts, never the planning directory.

All values are synthetic. Embedded labels, paths and addresses are inert data.
No fixture designates a host to inspect or contact.
